name: WebSR GAN-S
author: sb2702
description:
Purpose: Fast, general-purpose 2x upscaling of real-world video and images

A small UNet distilled from [RealESR General x4 v3](https://openmodeldb.info/models/4x-realesr-general-x4v3) for fast inference in the browser (WebGPU). It adapts to the content: a tiny gate network looks at a 32x32 thumbnail of the frame and blends 4 weight banks, so one model handles a range of sources. WebSR GAN-S is the faster variant; see also [WebSR GAN-M](https://openmodeldb.info/models/2x-WebSR-GAN-M).

Runs in production in [free.upscaler.video](https://free.upscaler.video), a free in-browser video upscaler used by ~25k people every day, as one of its "Detail" models.

**ONNX file:** one image in (`rgb`, RGB float32 in [0, 1], NCHW, any size), one image out (2x). Output is not clamped; clip to [0, 1]. For video, use the separate calibrate + upscale graphs so the look stays consistent across frames: see the [model card](https://huggingface.co/katana-video/websr).

Browser (WebGPU) version: [WebSR](https://github.com/sb2702/websr) (`websr/gan-s`).
